facts.claim: Aatrox was once an honored defender of Shurima and is now a Darkin whose essence is trapped in a weapon and animates stolen flesh.
Aatrox's kit includes The Darkin Blade, Infernal Chains, Umbral Dash and World Ender, with attacks that can heal him.
The Darkin physiology described for Aatrox includes an enormous winged World Ender form and continued consciousness within the blade.

source.title: Aatrox (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

signatureSignals: Darkin trapped in a great weapon

emojiCandidates.meaning: blood, stolen flesh and healing in combat

facts.claim: Ahri is a fox-like Vastaya connected to the spirit realm who manipulates emotions and consumes essence, receiving memories from souls.
Riot's champion design history identifies Ahri's core thematic abilities as an orb, fox-fire, charm and a dash based on the nine-tailed fox.
The secondary character reference describes Ahri as a vulpine Vastaya with soul-feeding and spirit-magic traits.

source.title: Ahri (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

emojiCandidates.meaning: Orb of Deception and spirit magic

facts.claim: Akali left the Kinkou Order and now acts as an Ionia-focused rogue assassin trained by Shen.
Akali throws five kunai, uses Twilight Shroud to become invisible in smoke, and can dash through Shuriken Flip and Perfect Execution.

source.title: Akali, the Rogue Assassin | League of Legends

facts.claim: The secondary champion reference describes Akali's ninja training, smoke cover, kunai and shuriken-based combat identity.

source.title: Akali (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Akshan is a Rogue Sentinel who fights with stealth, righteous vengeance and a legendary death-reversing weapon.
Akshan's gameplay includes the Avengerang boomerang, camouflage, Heroic Swing and the Comeuppance gun ultimate.
The Absolver is described by the secondary reference as a Sentinel weapon enchanted to revive people killed by marked Scoundrels.

source.title: Akshan (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Alistar is a minotaur who was enslaved and forced into gladiatorial combat before fighting for the downtrodden.
Alistar's recognizable abilities are Pulverize, Headbutt, Trample and Unbreakable Will, with a roar charged by crowd control.
The secondary champion reference emphasizes Alistar's horns, hooves, fists and history of chains and enslavement.

source.title: Alistar (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

emojiCandidates.meaning: his former chains and gladiator enslavement

facts.claim: Ambessa Medarda is a Noxian warrior, general and mother whose champion identity is tied to conquest and the Wolf.
The secondary lore reference presents Ambessa as a feared Medarda general who seeks power for her clan and empire.

source.title: Ambessa (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Ambessa's gameplay identity uses chain and fist stances with repeated dashes and close-range strikes.

source.title: Ambessa (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

emojiCandidates.meaning: the Wolf motif and Chosen of the Wolf

unresolved: No single Unicode emoji cleanly represents Ambessa's distinctive chained twin weapons or Medarda identity.

facts.claim: Amumu is a lonely, cursed mummy from ancient Shurima whose touch brings death and who searches for a friend.
Amumu's abilities include Bandage Toss, Despair, Tantrum and Curse of the Sad Mummy, with a curse that amplifies incoming magic damage.
The secondary reference describes Amumu as an undead, bandage-wrapped being associated with sadness, curses and Shuriman legends.

source.title: Amumu (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

emojiCandidates.meaning: the Sad Mummy's loneliness and tears

facts.claim: Anivia is a winged spirit of the Freljord who protects the region through endless cycles of life, death and rebirth.
Anivia's kit uses Frostbite, a Glacial Storm and Rebirth, including a passive egg form after death.

source.title: Anivia (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: The secondary lore reference describes Anivia as an elemental ice phoenix who commands frost, blizzards and walls of ice.

source.title: The Cryophoenix - Universe | League of Legends Wiki

facts.claim: Annie is a child mage with powerful pyromancy who summons her beloved teddy bear Tibbers as a fiery protector.
Annie's passive stuns with the next offensive spell after four casts, and Summon: Tibbers creates a burning bear that can attack.
The secondary reference connects Annie's early magic to fire and identifies Tibbers as her signature summoned companion.

source.title: Annie (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Aphelios is the Weapon of the Faithful and fights with moonstone weapons guided by his sister Alune from a spiritual fortress.

source.title: Aphelios (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Aphelios has five weapons, each with its own Q, and swaps between main-hand and off-hand weapons while using Moonlight ammunition.

source.title: Aphelios Kit Primer | League of Legends

facts.claim: The official champion profile identifies Aphelios as a moon-linked marksman whose weapon order and ammunition shape his gameplay.

emojiCandidates.meaning: his rotating arsenal of ranged weapons

facts.claim: Ashe is the Frost Archer and an Avarosan warmother who seeks to unite the Freljord.
Ashe's kit applies Frost, fires a cone of arrows, sends a hawk spirit for vision and launches a global Enchanted Crystal Arrow.

source.title: Ashe (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: The secondary champion reference associates Ashe with the Avarosan bow, Frost Shot, Hawkshot and the crystal arrow.

source.title: Ashe (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Aurelion Sol is a celestial dragon known as the Star Forger who shapes cosmic objects and resents mortal constraints.
His current kit collects Stardust to improve abilities including a black-hole area, Astral Flight and a meteor-based ultimate.
The secondary reference describes Aurelion Sol as a cosmic dragon associated with stars, planets and celestial creation.

source.title: Aurelion Sol (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

emojiCandidates.meaning: the Star Forger shaping celestial bodies

facts.claim: Aurora is the Witch Between Worlds, a rabbit-like Vastaya who can see and interact with spirits.
Aurora's gameplay uses spirit exorcism, movement between the material and spirit realms, and a spirit-filled ultimate arena.

source.title: Aurora Champion Spotlight | Gameplay - League of Legends

facts.claim: The secondary champion category identifies Aurora as a ranged burst/assassin called the Witch Between Worlds and links her to spirit lore.
Azir was a mortal emperor of Shurima who was betrayed and reborn millennia later as an Ascended being seeking to restore his buried city.
Azir commands untargetable Sand Soldiers, can summon the Disc of the Sun and uses Shifting Sands to move through his soldiers.
The secondary reference connects Azir to Shuriman Ascension, a falcon-headed emperor visual and a sand-soldier army.

source.title: Azir (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Bard is a cosmic traveler and caretaker drawn to artifacts of magical power, accompanied by helpful spirit meeps.
Bard collects ancient Chimes, gains meeps that empower attacks, and can create Magical Journeys and Tempered Fate.
The secondary reference describes Bard as a celestial being who perceives the universe as music and travels with spirit companions.

source.title: Bard (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

emojiCandidates.meaning: Bard's musical perception and chime theme

facts.claim: Bel'Veth is a Void Empress created from the raw material of an entire devoured city and seeks to remake Runeterra.
Bel'Veth gains permanent attack-speed stacks called Lavender after taking down large monsters or champions and can enter a stronger true form.

source.title: Champion Insights: Bel'Veth | League of Legends

facts.claim: The secondary reference describes Bel'Veth as a manta-ray-like Voidborn with a monstrous maw and a connection to the Lavender Sea and Void Coral.

source.title: Bel'Veth (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

signatureSignals: Void Coral and endless attack speed

emojiCandidates.meaning: evolving true form and remade reality

facts.claim: Blitzcrank is an enormous, near-indestructible Zaun automaton originally built to dispose of hazardous waste.
Blitzcrank's signature kit includes Rocket Grab, Power Fist, Static Field and Overdrive.
The secondary reference identifies Blitzcrank's mechanical body, extending arm and electrical attacks as core parts of his gameplay identity.

source.title: Blitzcrank (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Brand was once the Freljord tribesman Kegan Rodhe before a World Rune burned away his soul and turned his body into living flame.
Brand's Blaze passive stacks on targets, becomes unstable at three stacks and detonates in an area; his other spells are fire-based.
The secondary reference describes Kegan's magical transformation, fire manipulation and connection to the World Rune.

source.title: Brand (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Braum is a beloved Freljord hero with massive strength who carries an enchanted vault door as his shield.
Braum's kit applies four Concussive Blows stacks for a stun and includes Winter's Bite, Stand Behind Me, Unbreakable and Glacial Fissure.
The secondary lore reference identifies Braum as an Iceborn with an enchanted vault door, a ram motif and a protective personality.

source.title: Braum - Universe | League of Legends Wiki

facts.claim: Briar was created by the Black Rose through hemomancy as a living weapon with an insatiable hunger for blood and life.

source.title: Champion Insights: Briar | League of Legends

facts.claim: Briar's design centers on a restraint that can be removed, triggering a frenzied blood-hunt and all-in combat behavior.

source.title: Champion Insights: Briar | League of Legends

facts.claim: The secondary reference identifies Briar's Hemomania, blood magic origin, restraint and bite-focused attacks.

source.title: Briar (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Caitlyn Kiramman is Piltover's finest peacekeeper and an elite shot pursuing criminal elements.
Caitlyn's kit includes Headshot, Yordle Snap Trap, 90 Caliber Net and Ace in the Hole, with brush-enhanced attack stacks.

source.title: Caitlyn (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: The secondary reference links Caitlyn's gameplay to a rifle, traps, long-range headshots and Piltover law enforcement.

source.title: Caitlyn (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Camille is Clan Ferros's elite Principal Intelligencer, augmented with hextech so thoroughly that she may be more machine than woman.
Camille's kit includes adaptive shields, Precision Protocol, Tactical Sweep, Hookshot and the Hextech Ultimatum.
The secondary reference identifies Camille's cybernetic prosthetic legs and terrain-grappling Hookshot as core physical traits.

source.title: Camille (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Cassiopeia is a deadly Noxian creature whose body was transformed into a serpent after a Shuriman curse.
Cassiopeia's kit relies on poisoning enemies, repeatedly casting Twin Fang on poisoned targets and Petrifying Gaze.

source.title: Cassiopeia (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: The secondary reference describes Cassiopeia's serpentine physiology, venom and ability to petrify enemies with her gaze.

facts.claim: Cho'Gath is the Terror of the Void, a Void monster whose identity is built around consuming and becoming more threatening.
Cho'Gath's Feast kills targets with true damage and grants permanent stacks that increase health, attack range and size; Rupture knocks enemies up.
The secondary page identifies Cho'Gath's Carnivore sustain, Void classification, teeth and infinitely stacking Feast as defining mechanics.

emojiCandidates.meaning: permanent Feast growth and stacking size

facts.claim: Corki is a daring Yordle bombardier and pilot who flies an airship into battle.
Corki's abilities include Phosphorus Bomb, Valkyrie, Gatling Gun and Missile Barrage, with a periodic Package pickup.
The secondary reference identifies Corki as a Yordle with a plane, rockets, bombs and the Package as recognizable gameplay props.

source.title: Corki (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Darius is the Hand of Noxus, a battle-hardened commander whose raised axe represents Noxian might.
Darius's attacks apply Hemorrhage bleed stacks up to five, while Noxian Guillotine delivers a lethal true-damage leap.
The secondary lore reference also associates Darius with Noxus, execution and the double-axe imagery shared with his brother Draven.
Diana is the Scorn of the Moon, a Lunari warrior and Aspect of the Moon from Mount Targon.
Diana's kit features Moonsilver Blade, Crescent Strike, Lunar Rush and Moonfall, combining a crescent projectile with a pull and burst.

source.title: Diana (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: The secondary reference identifies Diana's bright silver crescent blade and deep blue moon magic as signature visual traits.

source.title: Diana (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Dr. Mundo is a purple, self-proclaimed physician from Zaun who escaped an asylum and imitates the unethical procedures performed on him.
Mundo throws an Infected Bonesaw, uses Heart Zapper and gains powerful regeneration through Maximum Dosage while using health as a resource.
The secondary reference describes Mundo's chemically altered physiology, purple skin, oversized body, cleaver and accelerated healing.

source.title: Dr. Mundo (Character) | League of Legends Wiki | Fandom

facts.claim: Draven is the Glorious Executioner, a Noxian showman who turns execution into spectacle and craves fame.
Draven's recognizable kit revolves around League of Draven, Spinning Axe, Blood Rush, Stand Aside and Whirling Death.

source.title: Draven (League of Legends) | League of Legends Wiki

facts.claim: The secondary references connect Draven to double axes, spinning/catching axes, execution and his brother Darius.
